featured_reviews.name: Ronak Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased a gold chain from Antara Jewellers, Borivali West, Mumbai on 24th December 2023 and paid a labour/making charge of approximately ₹680 per gram. Within 6 months of purchase, the chain started separating, and the issue was immediately brought to the store’s attention (see attached pictures showing the defect in the chain). At that time, Smita from the store acknowledged the issue and assured us it would be resolved.
Over time, the problem worsened. The chain continued to separate due to a design/manufacturing defect, not due to misuse or normal wear and tear. This defect was confirmed by Naresh (Store Manager) and Mahesh (Floor Manager). The store also confirmed that the chain cannot be repaired.
When we approached the store for a resolution, we were open to purchasing a new chain with higher gold weight, only requesting that the earlier labour/making charges be adjusted or honored as a goodwill gesture, given that the defect occurred within 6 months of purchase and was related to the original product’s design/manufacture.
However, the store refused to acknowledge or adjust the previously paid labour charges, offering no fair or reasonable resolution for a confirmed manufacturing defect. This was disappointing, especially from a reputed jeweller, as customers expect accountability and ethical after-sales support.
While quality issues can occur, how they are handled matters. In this case, the lack of responsibility, ownership, and flexibility has significantly affected my trust. I hope the management reviews this approach and adopts more customer-centric solutions in genuine defect cases.

I visited the Tanishq store in Borivali West after being specifically referred here by the Goregaon store, as this location is larger and supposedly offers a wider variety of ring collections. Unfortunately, this turned out to be a complete waste of time.

The staff was shockingly disinterested and unprofessional. The person assigned to assist us made zero effort to understand our preferences or show designs based on what we clearly requested. Instead, he casually dumped ring racks on the table and walked away, leaving us to browse on our own. Most of the rings weren’t even available in proper sizes, showing a clear lack of concern for customers.

Basic customer service was completely missing. No water, no refreshments, no engagement—despite us spending a considerable amount of time in the store. We were repeatedly ignored, which is unacceptable for any store, let alone a so-called premium brand like Tanishq.

When shopping for something as important and expensive as diamond rings, customers expect professionalism, attention, and respect. This store delivered none of that. The experience was drastically worse compared to other Tanishq outlets like Goregaon , Andheri (Lokhandwala), where service standards are far superior.

Overall, this store reflects extremely poor staff attitude and weak management oversight. I strongly do NOT recommend this location and sincerely hope the management takes corrective action, because this level of service seriously damages the brand’s reputation.
